scope: ordinary six-slot non-godweapon templates with nonempty fully-known flat base effects and explicit clean instances
mapping_provenance: client_verified unique cattributedesconfig numid links; not subtract-one inference
templates: intersect citemattr with cequipeffect; itemtype low nibble8 and slot nibble0..5; exclude explicit cgodweapon; require nonempty base effects and known flat IDs; only extra zero tail values may be trimmed
suiting: preserve original metadata; nonzero is pending unverified set semantics and refuses final projection, even for a clean instance; do not infer inactive set effects from prefix/score
composition: designed current naked growth plus actual current equipped original flat totals; no incremental double addition; zero durability contributes no effects

eligibility.slot: client_verified itemtype nibble and original equipment dispatch
eligibility.characters: client_verified slot0 roleNeed empty unrestricted, nonempty OR of original character IDs; nonweapon dispatcher does not apply roleNeed; preserve original20/21 values even though current ten characters cannot match
eligibility.sex: client_verified sexNeed0 unrestricted, otherwise exact original role sex; original shape remainder1..5 ->1, remainder0/6..9 ->2
eligibility.minimum_level: designed server enforcement role level>=original citemattr.needLevel, preserving existing Inventory policy; generic client use compares needLevel but direct equipment dispatch does not prove original server enforcement
eligibility.instance: designed restricted clean profile: identified1, prefix_quality1, score0, exact original base_properties, condition color1, known durability; quality modifiers absent

sealing_basis.provenance: designed; old roles require explicit known strength and resistance; missing resistance is unknown, never default0

resources: requires role-resources-v1 single carrier and explicit resource-aware totals/composition; legacy mixed projection is refused; equip/wear/repair never heal and lower caps clip
unsupported: original combat balance or sealing success formula
activation: explicit loader and basis policy only; default v1 loader unchanged; no automatic old basis/resource profile migration; shared activation and six-slot runtime require separate verification
